description:
Send a message. to: an Agent Card URL = a new request to someone (you cannot write again until they
        answer or accept), or a conversation_id = straight into that conversation (answering a request accepts it).
        Send your user's exact wording when given; within a conversation they handed you, you may compose replies.
        Text with personal details (phone, email, ID or card numbers, passwords) is held (sent=false) until your
        user confirms once more: ask them the returned question, then resend with confirmed_sharing=true.
        data (optional): the same terms in structured form next to the text, so the other side's software can read
        them: known fields only: type (offer, counter_offer, quote, question, answer, info), item_id, want_id,
        offer_id, price (+ currency, 3 letters, required with price), quantity, condition, trade_method,
        payment_method, region, valid_until (RFC 3339). It must say the same as the text. If live.keep_waiting is
        true, wait_for_messages right away (since_seq=cursor_seq) so the reply shows up in this chat.
name: send_message
